support_faq1_q: How are my files turned into summaries and quizzes?
support_faq1_a: When you add a source, it’s processed into a knowledge base scoped to that workspace. Chat answers and generated summaries, flashcards, and quizzes are grounded only in your own materials.
support_faq2_a: Workspaces are private by default. You can switch one to public or share it with a link from the workspace’s edit menu. Nothing is shared until you choose to.
support_faq3_q: Can I import from Google Drive or OneDrive?
support_faq3_a: Yes — open a workspace, choose Add source, and pick a drive. Drive import activates once the backend connection is set up; uploading from your computer works today.
support_faq4_q: What kinds of quiz questions can I generate?
support_faq4_a: Multiple choice, multi-select, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, short answer, matching, and ordering — across easy, medium, and hard difficulty. Pick the mix when you generate.
support_faq5_q: How does the login streak work?
support_faq5_a: Open Evo Notes on consecutive days to grow your streak, shown at the top of the dashboard. Miss a day and it resets — no penalty beyond starting again.
